latest_semantic_finding.exact_claim: At the pinned official _base_client.py, SyncAPIClient.__init__ validates an optional httpx.Client and assigns self._client = http_client or SyncHttpxClientWrapper(...). The synchronous request path calls self._client.send(request, ...), and after a response is obtained it returns self._process_response(..., response=response, ...). Combined only with own prior p1-sa-431 evidence that Groq.__init__ forwards the supplied http_client into SyncAPIClient and binds Chat to the same Groq instance, this closes the static source-level bridge from caller-supplied client injection through SDK send and response processing.
